import narwhals as nw

def clean_df(df):
    df = nw.from_native(df)
    df = df.with_columns(
        nw.col("quantity").fill_null(0),
        nw.col("region").fill_null("unknown"),
    )
    return df.to_native()

df = clean_df(df)
